guide_hero_subtitle: A .NET 10 + SvelteKit template with auth, admin panel, background jobs, and observability built in. The CRM pipeline you see here is a sample app to showcase real-world patterns. Explore below, then clone it and make it yours.
guide_tour_description: Walk through every feature step by step with a guided tour. It only takes a minute and covers everything NETrock has to offer.
guide_features_description: Each card highlights a key area of the template - click through to try them out.
guide_disclaimer_description: NETrock is not a CRM product - it's an open-source template that ships with a sample CRM pipeline to demonstrate real-world patterns. Everything you see here is meant to be customized and extended for your own project.
guide_gettingStarted_description: Like what you see? Follow the step-by-step guide to clone the template and have it running on your machine in minutes.
guide_step1_description: You've created your account. NETrock is a full-stack template - .NET API + SvelteKit frontend with authentication, admin panel, and more features built in.
guide_step2_description: You're already using it! JWT tokens with refresh rotation, email verification, password reset, remember-me cookies - all built-in and tested.
guide_step3_description: Customize your profile with your name, avatar, phone number, and bio.
guide_step4_description: Build your sales pipeline - add contacts, track deal values, and manage leads.
guide_step5_description: View pipeline visualizations - deal values by status, source distribution, and recent activity.
guide_step6_description: User management, role assignment, account locking. The complete administrator experience.

tour_welcome_description: This is a full-stack template built for real workloads - .NET API with SvelteKit frontend. Let me show you what's inside.
tour_personas_description: Startup, dev team, solo builder, or learner - see exactly how NETrock fits your use case and saves you months of setup.
tour_diagram_description: Your .NET API is the hub. SvelteKit, mobile apps, external services - plug in any frontend you need. One backend, endless possibilities.
tour_architecture_description: SvelteKit frontend talks to the .NET API, backed by PostgreSQL, with HybridCache, OpenTelemetry, MinIO storage, and Hangfire jobs. All wired up and ready to go.
tour_techStack_description: Every tool hand-picked and pre-configured - from Svelte 5 to .NET 10, with OpenTelemetry and .NET Aspire. Built to ship from day one.
tour_contacts_description: Search, filter, create, edit, bulk-delete - a real working pipeline. This is exactly the kind of feature you'd be building, or that gets built for you. The possibilities are endless.
tour_analytics_description: Pipeline breakdowns, source distribution, recent activity - all driven by real data. Imagine this with your own metrics, your own business logic.
tour_admin_description: User management, role assignment with granular permissions, scheduled background jobs - everything an admin panel needs, already built.
tour_tools_description: Switch languages, toggle light/dark theme, manage your account - the finishing touches that make it feel polished.
tour_roleSwitcher_description: Switch between User and Admin to see how the UI adapts. Admin manages users and roles within the organization. User has basic access. Custom roles enable specific features without overloading people who only need parts of the system. SuperAdmin (platform owner) is excluded from the demo to protect PII and maintain real security boundaries.
meta_howItWorks_description: Discover the NETrock template architecture and tech stack.
howItWorks_hero_subtitle: A .NET 10 + SvelteKit template that ships with authentication, admin panel, background jobs, and more - so you can skip months of infrastructure work and start building features from day one.
howItWorks_architecture_description: Requests flow from the SvelteKit frontend through an API proxy to the .NET backend, which follows Clean Architecture with strict layer separation.
howItWorks_techStack_description: Modern, battle-tested technologies chosen for developer experience and production reliability.
howItWorks_quality_description: Every line of code passes through multiple quality gates - from AI-assisted development to automated testing and enforced conventions.
howItWorks_quality_ai_description: Claude Code follows project conventions defined in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. The AI understands the architecture and writes code that matches existing patterns - including tests.
howItWorks_quality_testing_description: Unit tests for pure logic, component tests for business rules, API integration tests for the HTTP pipeline, and architecture tests to enforce layer dependencies.
howItWorks_quality_conventions_descripti: Result pattern for error handling, TimeProvider for testable time, FluentValidation, ProblemDetails (RFC 9457), and strict TypeScript - no 'any' allowed.
howItWorks_quality_security_description: Permission-based authorization, CSRF protection, rate limiting, CSP with nonces, HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, and HttpOnly cookies.
howItWorks_features_description: Everything you need to launch a production application - already wired up, tested, and ready to extend.
howItWorks_features_authDesc: Token rotation, refresh, email verification, password reset, remember-me
howItWorks_features_permissionsDesc: Granular permissions, role hierarchy, full admin user management
howItWorks_features_emailDesc: Liquid templates, Resend integration, verification and reset flows
howItWorks_features_jobsDesc: Hangfire with PostgreSQL storage, recurring and one-time, admin UI
howItWorks_features_filesDesc: S3-compatible via MinIO, avatar processing with SkiaSharp
howItWorks_features_auditDesc: Append-only event log, per-user history, admin audit views
howItWorks_features_cacheDesc: HybridCache with L1 in-process, pluggable L2 distributed backend
howItWorks_features_apiDocsDesc: OpenAPI auto-generated, Scalar interactive UI, versioned endpoints
howItWorks_features_i18nDesc: Compile-time i18n with Paraglide, type-safe, EN + CS included
howItWorks_features_healthDesc: PostgreSQL, MinIO probes for container orchestration readiness
howItWorks_features_rateLimitDesc: Per-endpoint sliding window policies with friendly error responses
howItWorks_features_dockerDesc: Aspire orchestrator with integrated OTEL dashboard and pinned ports
welcome_splash_subtitle: A .NET + SvelteKit starter you can explore live - then clone it and ship your own.
welcome_pillar_auth_desc: JWT with refresh rotation, email verification, password reset - done right
welcome_pillar_admin_desc: Users, roles, granular permissions, full audit trail - ready to go
welcome_pillar_jobs_desc: Scheduled tasks with history, pause, resume, and on-demand triggers
welcome_pillar_infra_desc: Aspire, health checks, i18n, OpenTelemetry, file storage - all wired up
welcome_tech_tests: No vendor lock-in. No monthly fees. Fork it, modify it, ship it - it's yours.
welcome_privacy_noCollection: Zero tracking - we don't collect, sell, or analyze your information
welcome_privacy_anonymized: Fully sandboxed - demo data lives in isolation, never linked to you
welcome_privacy_cleared: Auto-cleaned - all demo data is wiped on a regular schedule
welcome_cta_subtitle: Create a free account and put every feature through its paces. Like what you see? Clone the repo and make it yours.
welcome_cta_note: No credit card. No strings. Just code.

meta_gettingStarted_description: From template to running app in 5 steps.
gettingStarted_hero_subtitle: Five steps to go from "Use this template" to a fully running application on your machine. Works on Windows, macOS, and Linux out of the box.
gettingStarted_prereq_description: Make sure you have these tools installed before you begin. Don't worry - the init script will catch any missing dependencies for you.
gettingStarted_prereq_dockerDesc: Container runtime for the full stack - required
gettingStarted_prereq_dotnetDesc: Required - builds and runs the backend
gettingStarted_steps_description: Follow along from start to finish - you'll be up and running in minutes.
gettingStarted_step1_description: Head to the NETrock GitHub repository and click the "Use this template" button.
gettingStarted_step1_note: Look for the "Use this template" button near the top of the page.
gettingStarted_step2_description: GitHub will ask you to name your new repository and choose its visibility. Pick a name, set it to public or private, and click "Create repository".
gettingStarted_step2_note: Your new repo starts clean - same foundation as this demo, without the sample data.
gettingStarted_step3_description: Clone your new repository and run the initialization script to set up your project.
gettingStarted_step3_note: The init script renames the solution, updates namespaces, and sets up Aspire orchestration.
gettingStarted_step4_description: Launch the full development stack with a single Aspire command.
gettingStarted_step4_note: Aspire starts PostgreSQL, MinIO, the API, and SvelteKit frontend with an integrated OpenTelemetry dashboard.
gettingStarted_step5_description: Your app is running. Open your IDE or Claude Code and start building.
gettingStarted_step5_local_description: Or run the frontend and API directly outside Aspire - they connect to the database and storage services automatically.
gettingStarted_step5_note: Ports are configurable via environment variables. See the README for details.
gettingStarted_checklist_description: Once you're up and running, here are some recommended next steps.
gettingStarted_checklist_item1: Connect an email provider (SMTP, Resend, Postmark…)
gettingStarted_checklist_item2: Build your first feature following SKILLS.md
gettingStarted_checklist_item3: Set up CORS, JWT secret & CAPTCHA for production
gettingStarted_checklist_item5: Review the Before You Ship checklist
